knownDefects.summary: Exact-lane targeted and long-soak tests are committed but no existing automatic workflow executes them on parallel branch push.
Provider-specific production adapters must be bound by convergence/domain owners after their V1X provider checkpoints are selected.

adversarialFindings: A scheduler dispatch edge could temporarily count a runnable job as queued and reject context-recovery work; fixed by claiming available worker slots synchronously.
Rejected materialization results must release returned CPU/GPU handles; cleanup was made fail-closed before checkpoint 1.

resourceEvidence.semanticInvariant: Adaptive quality is presentation input only; materializers must echo an independently computed semantic digest and unchanged identity or are rejected.
